review.assessment: The change introduces solution.ts containing a makeGrid function that initializes all rows by filling them with a single shared array reference. This fails to create independent row arrays as required, so mutating one cell incorrectly propagates to every other row. The provided code contains the exact structural bug described in the task and does not implement the fix.

findings.defect: Rows share the same array reference due to .fill() misuse
